profile: feature engineering: Feature engineering comprises an array of techniques applied to data before they are used by either supervised or unsupervised models. It involves designing features so that models receive properly designed inputs, ideally with models finding or learning features themselves. In nonlinear cases, feature engineering determines the functional form of nonlinearities through human expertise.
